lessons.failure: Redacted request presented as original wire bytes
lessons.prevention: Bind raw SHA-256 from independently supplied handoff manifest; reject redacted hash mismatch.

lessons.failure: Ciphertext tampering or wrong decryption key
lessons.prevention: AEAD authentication fails closed without returning plaintext.

lessons.failure: Encrypted record swapped between capture IDs
lessons.prevention: Bind random record ID into authenticated associated data and check capture/run IDs inside ciphertext.
Reject unsafe POSIX modes and symlinked final components; operator must secure ancestors.

lessons.failure: Secret value leaked into logs or error messages
lessons.prevention: Only code-based failures; no raw bytes, identifiers, key or payload in return objects.

lessons.failure: Incomplete HTTP 200 response misclassified as successful analysis
lessons.prevention: Escrow match is only byte consistency; signed numerical-result and analysis-completion gates remain mandatory.

lessons.failure: Untrusted metadata defines its own handoff policy
lessons.prevention: Require separate trusted v1 manifest with expected domain and version; never infer trust from escrow file.

lessons.failure: Prototype filesystem controls assumed valid on Windows
lessons.prevention: Fail closed on non-POSIX platforms pending Windows ACL/reparse/atomic-publish review.

lessons.failure: Local ciphertext mistaken for independently witnessed capture
lessons.prevention: Maintain distinct offline-binding, witness, live-analysis and engineering-acceptance states.

lessons.failure: Crash leaves a partial or orphaned record
lessons.prevention: Write ciphertext to private temporary file, fsync and atomically publish; require controlled orphan cleanup and independent recovery testing.
